title: observability: add dashboard-seed job and alert-promotion operator for private installs
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Adds an idempotent dashboard seeding job plus a small operator that automates safe promotion of alert rules and dashboard provisioning across tenant folders. Includes Terraform variable for enabling the feature and Helm value defaults. No user-facing breaking changes.
description:
Motivation and summary: This PR introduces two cooperating automation pieces for private installs: (1) a dashboard-seed CronJob + provisioning sidecar pattern to ensure Grafana tenant folders are populated deterministically on first install and after upgrades, and (2) an alert-promotion Kubernetes operator that can safely move PrometheusRule alerts from a cluster-wide 'staging' namespace into tenant-scoped folders with optional canary promotion semantics. The goal is to reduce manual dashboard and alert bootstrap steps for air-gapped/private customers and to make rolling upgrades/rollbacks of alert rules safe and auditable.

What changed (high level):
- New k8s controller: observability/alert-promotion-operator (small controller in Go) - watches PrometheusRule staging namespace and creates/updates tenant-scoped PrometheusRule objects + creates a corresponding Grafana provisioning manifest to surface the alerts in tenant folders. Promotion is opt-in via annotation and supports a 'promote-once' safe guard.
- Dashboard seeding: chart/grafana/templates/cronjob-dashboard-seed.yaml - CronJob uses the grafana-provisioning sidecar approach and a one-shot seeding container to upload JSON dashboards on initial creation. It is idempotent and uses a ConfigMap-backed list of seeds.
- Prometheus state migration helper: tools/prom-migrate/ - small idempotent helper to rename legacy label keys used in older private installs (cluster_id -> tenant_id) and to copy over recording rule names safely when customers upgrade from older versions. This helper is invoked as part of the Helm post-upgrade hook when migration_needed=true.
- Terraform: modules/private-installer/main.tf - adds optional input enable_observability_seed (default false) and a toggle for Grafana provisioning RBAC and storage class for dashboard artifacts.
- Helm: values.yaml and chart defaults updated with feature toggles, RBAC roles for the operator, and reasonable resource requests/limits.
- E2E: e2e/observability/ - added smoke tests that validate seeding runs on a fresh cluster and that promotion operator correctly creates tenant PrometheusRule + Grafana provisioning entry.

Commits (summary):
- 7f3a1c9: initial operator scaffold + CRD wiring
- b1d4f7e: implement promotion logic + annotation handling and locking
- c2e8a2a: add dashboard seed cronjob, provisioning templates, and example seeding manifests
- 1a9f4bb: terraform input and docs for enabling feature in private installs
- 4c5d9ea: add prom-migrate helper and helm hook integration
- 9b7e2d3: tests, CI fixes, and RBAC adjustments after review

Files changed (high level):
- charts/grafana/templates/cronjob-dashboard-seed.yaml
- charts/grafana/values.yaml (seed list, sidecar toggles)

review_thread: Evelyn Park (reviewer): Are we sure the seeding approach works in air-gapped installs without external internet access? Please document the required bundle layout.
Author (Priya): The seed job uses bundled JSONs supplied via the installer tarball; I've added docs and an example tar layout under docs/private-installer/observability-seed.md.
Tomás Silva (reviewer): RBAC looks permissive for the operator - can you narrow permissions to just configmaps, prometheusrules, and provisionings? Also add tests for operator restart resilience.

Author: Reduced RBAC to a tight set (ConfigMaps, PrometheusRule, Secrets for grafana credentials, and a custom provisioning ConfigMap). Added controller unit test for leader election and restart recovery.
Aisha Khan (reviewer): Add exponential backoff for API errors when creating Grafana provisioning manifests (we've seen 429s during large installs).
Author: Added retry with jitter and added note in release docs recommending controller CPU/Memory defaults for contention scenarios.
Tomás (approver): Verified on local airgapped cluster and example tenant; approving now.
qa_notes: To test in an airgapped env: run the provided 'seed-bundle' tarball through the installer and verify grafana tenant folder has seeded dashboards
Prom-migrate has a --dry-run flag; customers are advised to run this before enabling migration_needed
merge_summary: Squash merged by Tomás Silva after approvals. Migration helper is gated behind helm flag and disabled by default; feature must be explicitly enabled by integrators.
post_merge_actions: Backfill packaging: include seeded dashboards in the next private-installer release artifact
Announce in the private-installer changelog and migration notes
Follow-up ticket ENG-2101 to add metrics for operator promotions and failures
notes_on_rollback: Operator and cronjob are designed to be safe on rollback: seeding is idempotent and promotion operator marks promoted rules with an annotation so the Helm rollback can detect and preserve vs delete. Prom-migrate writes no-destructive operations unless --apply is passed.
changelog_entry: Private installs: opt-in dashboard seeding and alert promotion operator (enable via terraform/helm flag). Includes migration helper for legacy label keys. See docs/private-installer/observability-seed.md for usage.
known_issues: If customers run both old and new installers simultaneously there can be transient duplicate provisioning entries; operator dedup logic mitigates but recommend one-time transition window
E2E observed rare timing issue when Grafana provisioning folder creation and seeding run in the same second; we've added a small jitter and documented the potential retry in the job
security_considerations: RBAC scoped to minimal resources; grafana credentials are always pulled from customer-managed Secret. No new external network access is required for default behavior; seeding bundles are delivered with the installer artifact.
testing_summary: Local integration tests + e2e observability smoke tests run in CI. Verified airgapped install flow manually on customer-sim cluster. Added unit tests for controller and helm hook scenarios.
